title: Demon and Witches on Beach
description: A blue horned demon with glowing eyes stands shrouded in blue smoke between two seductive women on a tropical beach at dusk. The blonde woman in a dark blue corset holds a black candle surrounded by melted wax and black feathers, while the dark-haired woman in black lace sits on a palm tree trunk with candles forming a heart shape in the background.
prompt: A dramatic fantasy scene on a tropical beach at twilight with purple stormy skies. A muscular blue demon with large black horns and glowing eyes stands in swirling blue mystical smoke. To his left, a smiling blonde woman in a dark blue lace corset and garter holds a lit black candle, surrounded by melted candles, black feathers and a gold ring. To his right, a dark-haired woman with tattoos sits on a palm tree log dipping her feet in the ocean waves, wearing a black lace corset. Candles form a heart shape on the sand in the background near the water.
